_one_line: The ROOT object. The single thing this entire brain is about. Everything else — profile, capability model, domains, claims, incidents — is a statement ABOUT this object, and the traversal starts here.

_two_roots._note: The brain has TWO roots, of different kinds. Keeping them apart is the point.
_two_roots.core_principles (L0): the constitution of the AGENT — how we work, decide, store (CP-001/002/003). Governs OUR behaviour.
_two_roots.installation (ROOT): the SUBJECT — what we model. Governs what is TRUE about the customer.
_two_roots.why_it_matters: Until s097 only the agent-root existed. The subject was implicit in every layer and first-class in none — which is exactly how a question about the installation ('which modules are implemented?') found no home.

_anchor_not_container.rule: This object holds IDENTITY, AXES, POINTERS and the TRAVERSAL ORDER. It NEVER holds content that a store already owns.
_anchor_not_container.why: The failure mode of a root node is becoming a god-object: content gets copied upward, and now two places disagree. The stores stay the owners; the root only says WHAT THIS IS and WHERE TO ENTER.
_anchor_not_container.test: If you can delete a field here and lose information that exists nowhere else, that field is in the wrong place — push it down into its store.

axes._note: The five ways this installation is sliced. Each axis is owned by a store; the root only declares that the axis exists and who owns it.

1_module.question: what SAP application components does it run?

2_domain.question: what business domains does it have?

3_capability.question: what do WE KNOW about each domain?

5_channel.question: how is it operated and how does data cross the boundary?

traversal._design: THE FIRING ORDER — 'de aquí se dispara el resto'. Deterministic, not a suggestion. Each step names what it answers and what it hands to the next.
traversal.0_installation: WHAT IS THIS? -> identity above. Always the first read.
traversal.1_profile: WHAT DOES IT RUN? -> system_profile (L16): modules with evidence tiers, org structure, add-ons, front-end, users. `graph_queries.py profile`
traversal.2_operation: HOW IS IT RUN? -> system_profile.operating_model: 80.6% orchestrated by external satellites. Detail in knowledge/system_operating_model_rfc.md.
traversal.3_capability: WHAT DO WE KNOW ABOUT IT? -> capability_model (L15). `graph_queries.py capability_gaps`
traversal.4_delta: WHERE IS THE WORK? -> profile_links.system_level_blind_spots = modules it RUNS that we have NOT modelled. This is the backlog, generated not written.
traversal.5_evidence: PROVE IT -> claims (L4) + incidents (L11) + objects (L1). Never assert without this step.
traversal._invariant: Steps 0-1 are MANDATORY before answering any question about scope, modules, or how UNESCO works. Skipping them is what rule #171 exists to prevent.

what_hangs_off_this.system_profile: brain_v2/system_profile/ — L16. The DESCRIPTION of this object.
what_hangs_off_this.capability_model: brain_v2/capability_model/ — L15. Our KNOWLEDGE of this object.
what_hangs_off_this.claims_incidents: L4/L11 — the evidence trail for every assertion about it.
what_hangs_off_this.gold_db: Zagentexecution/sap_data_extraction/sqlite/p01_gold_master_data.db — its extracted data (LOCAL-ONLY, not in git).

_multi_tenant.status: single-tenant today (UNESCO-ECC), but the schema is deliberately tenant-keyed.
_multi_tenant.portable: the CONCEPTS (installation, profile, capability model, the 11 dimensions) + every build script + AS-DESIGNED standard baselines (standard SAP is system-invariant).
_multi_tenant.not_portable: everything under identity/, the whole system_profile instance, AS-RUN coverage and the G delta — those ARE the customer.
_multi_tenant.why_declared_now: capability_model._portability already claimed the model applies to other tenants, but with no installation object there was nothing to scope a second tenant AGAINST. This makes the seam explicit before it is needed, not after.
